# yii3-respect-validation

Bridge exposing Respect/Validation rules as native yiisoft/validator rules for Yii3.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-respect-validation
```

## Rules

- `declare(strict_types=1)` in every file.
- `RespectRule` is `final class` (not readonly) — needs mutable `$skipOnEmpty`/`$skipOnError`/`$when` for clone-based `with*`-style traits shared with native yii3 rules.
- Requires PHP `>=8.5` (forced by `respect/validation` ^3.1, which dropped 8.3/8.4 support).
- `RespectRuleHandler` never uses `Respect\Validation\Message\InterpolationRenderer` (needs `symfony/translation-contracts`) — messages are rendered by the handler itself so the whole app stays on one i18n pipeline (`Yiisoft\Translator`).
- Respect message templates use `{{param}}` (double braces), not ICU `{param}` — never pass them through `yiisoft/validator`'s default (ICU) formatter; use the dedicated `yii3-respect-validation` translation category with `RespectMessageFormatter`.
- No `@psalm-suppress` — fix the root cause.
- No JavaScript client-validation runtime is shipped (deliberate scope decision — Respect has ~150 rules, many with arbitrary PHP logic that can't be ported to JS affordably). `RespectRule::getOptions()` only exports metadata, matching how `yiisoft/validator` core itself does client-side export.

## API reference

### RespectRule

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3RespectValidation\RespectRule;
use Respect\Validation\Validators\AllOf;
use Respect\Validation\Validators\Between;
use Respect\Validation\Validators\Length;
use Respect\Validation\Validators\StringType;

final class RegisterForm
{
    #[RespectRule(new AllOf(new StringType(), new Length(new Between(1, 50))), skipOnEmpty: true)]
    public string $username = '';
}
```

Constructor: `__construct(Respect\Validation\Validator|Respect\Validation\ValidatorBuilder $validator, bool|callable|null $skipOnEmpty = null, bool $skipOnError = false, ?Closure $when = null)`.

Accepts either a raw `Validator` (e.g. `new AllOf(new StringType(), ...)` — required
for use directly as a PHP attribute argument, since attribute args must be constant
expressions) or a `ValidatorBuilder` (what `v::stringType()` returns — only usable
when the rule is built outside the attribute and passed as a variable). Note:
`Length` wraps another `Validator` (e.g. `Between`) to check against the extracted
length — it does not take `min`/`max` directly, and the `v::` fluent sugar for it
(`->length(min, max)`) does not auto-wrap into `Between` either; always build
`new Length(new Between($min, $max))` explicitly.

Implements `Yiisoft\Validator\DumpedRuleInterface`, `SkipOnEmptyInterface`,
`SkipOnErrorInterface`, `WhenInterface` — behaves exactly like a built-in
`yiisoft/validator` rule in the validation pipeline.

### RespectRuleHandler

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3RespectValidation\RespectRuleHandler;

new RespectRuleHandler(
    translator: null,                          // ?Yiisoft\Translator\TranslatorInterface
    translationCategory: 'yii3-respect-validation',
);
```

`validate(mixed $value, RuleInterface $rule, ValidationContext $context): Result`:
calls `$rule->getValidator()->evaluate($value)`, walks the returned
`Respect\Validation\Result` tree (`children` for composites like `AllOf`/`OneOf`,
`adjacent` for chained wrapper messages), and for each failed leaf calls
`Result::addErrorWithoutPostProcessing($renderedMessage, $parameters, $valuePath)`
— message is already fully translated+formatted, so the global (ICU) formatter
must not touch it again.

`$valuePath` is built by walking Respect's own `Path` linked list
(`$node->path->value`/`->parent`) — e.g. `Each`/`KeySet` attach the failing array
key there.

`{{subject}}` in Respect templates is filled with
`$context->getCapitalizedTranslatedProperty()` (same convention native rules use
for sentence-starting property names).

### RespectMessageFormatter

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3RespectValidation\RespectMessageFormatter;

(new RespectMessageFormatter())->format('{{subject}} must be a string', ['subject' => 'Name'], 'en');
// 'Name must be a string'
```

Implements `Yiisoft\Translator\MessageFormatterInterface`. Plain `strtr()`-based
`{{key}}` substitution — no ICU, no ordering requirements, unknown placeholders
left untouched, non-scalar values stringify to `''`.

### DI config (Yii3, config-plugin)

```php
// config/params.php
return [
    'rasuvaeff/yii3-respect-validation' => [
        'translation.category' => 'yii3-respect-validation',
    ],
];
```

Ships `config/di.php` registering `RespectRuleHandler`'s `translationCategory`
and a `CategorySource` (tag `translation.categorySource`) using
`RespectMessageFormatter`. The reader is `MessageSource` over the bundled
`messages/{locale}` catalogs (full Russian catalog included) when
`yiisoft/translator-message-php` is installed, falling back to `IdMessageReader`
(untranslated English) otherwise. Extra locales: add your own
`messages/<locale>/yii3-respect-validation.php` catalog, keyed by the exact
`{{param}}` template string, e.g. `'{{subject}} must be a string' => '...'`.
